metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2024 · Civil War
metas.description: In the midst of a U.S. civil war, four reporters make the dangerous trip to the capital to interview the president before he is overthrown.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2023 · The Zone of Interest
metas.description: The commandant of Auschwitz and his wife strive to build a dream life for their family in a house next to the camp.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2025 · Warfare
metas.description: A platoon of Navy SEALs embark on a dangerous mission in Ramadi, Iraq, with the chaos and brotherhood of war retold through their memories of the event.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2025 · The Voice of Hind Rajab
metas.description: Red Crescent volunteers receive an emergency call. A 6-year old girl is trapped in a car under IDF fire in Gaza, pleading for rescue. While trying to keep her on the line, they do everything they can to get an ambulance to her.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2023 · The Great Escaper
metas.description: Bernard Jordan escapes from his care home to attend the 70th Anniversary of the D-Day Landings in France.
